title: DoT & TSDSI Sign MoU under ₹203 Crore 'TDIP Scheme' for Bharat 6G Standardisation
summary: Provides up to 98% financial support to Indian startups/MSMEs for global SDO participation.

blocks.content: Provides up to 98% financial support to Indian startups/MSMEs for global SDO participation.

items: TDIP Scheme Outlay: ₹203 crore outlay (2026-2031) under Technology Development and Investment Promotion Scheme.
Financial Support: Up to 98% funding for startups (turnover ≤ ₹10 cr) and 80% (turnover ₹10 cr – ₹500 cr) to participate in 3GPP, ITU, and oneM2M standards meetings.
